description: Fabrikam (fictional) sells workforce analytics SaaS on Azure: multi-tenant API, background jobs, admin portal; buyers require SOC2-oriented diligence on access, change management, and subprocessors without exposing another customer's data.
constraints: Tenant isolation: no cross-tenant reads in the OLTP path; defense in depth for support break-glass
CI/CD: production deploys from signed builds only; manual approval for schema migrations
Secrets via Key Vault + managed identity; no long-lived keys in app settings for production
assumptions: Greenfield service — illustrative only for pilot evaluation
Entra ID is IdP for workforce customers (OIDC); no legacy SAML in this starter
inlineRequirements: Architecture review should surface evidence paths for change tickets, access reviews, and logging retention — as design hooks, not as proof of operating effectiveness
Vendor questionnaire mapping: logical access (CC6), change management (CC8) — narrative alignment only

documents.name: starter-disclaimer.txt
documents.content: Synthetic starter for pilot evaluation. Not confidential data. No SOC 2 opinion implied.

topologyHints: App Service or Container Apps behind Front Door; regional pairs for DR drill
